summary.text: Samakab Hussein is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 65A who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An accountant and business owner, he was born in Somalia and lives in St. Paul.

paragraphs.text: Samakab Hussein was born in Somalia and lives in St. Paul, Minnesota.
He earned a B.A. from St. Mary's University, and his career experience includes working as an accountant and business owner.
Hussein defeated John Schonebaum and Miki Frost in the 2022 general election for District 65A and took office on January 3, 2023, and he won re-election in 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Housing Finance and Policy, Legacy Finance (Co-Vice Chair), and Workforce and Business Development Finance and Policy committees.
